def writeU64Little (v : UInt64) : Vector UInt8 8 :=

def hexTable : Vector UInt8 16 :=
  ⟨"0123456789abcdef".toList.map (fun c => c.toUInt8), by
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_string, "0123456789abcdef".length]
    decide⟩

def bytesToHexLower (in : Vector UInt8 n) : Vector UInt8 (n * 2) :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
    if h : i < n then
      let b := in.get ⟨i, h⟩
      let h1 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val / 16).toNat, by decide⟩
      let h2 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val % 16).toNat, by decide⟩
      loop (i + 1) (h1 :: h2 :: acc)
    else acc
  Vector.mk (loop 0 []).reverse (by
    let fix := @loop
    have hlen : (fix 0 []).length = n * 2 := by
      let rec aux (i : Nat) (acc : List UInt8) : (fix i acc).length = acc.length + (n - i) * 2 := by
        simp only [fix]
        byCases hi : i < n
        case pos hi =>
          simp only [hi, ite_true, List.length_cons]
          rw [aux (i + 1) (hexTable.get ⟨(in.get ⟨i, hi⟩).val / 16, by decide⟩ :: hexTable.get ⟨(in.get ⟨i, hi⟩).val % 16, by decide⟩ :: acc)]
          omega
        case neg hi =>
          simp only [hi, ite_false]
          have hieq : i = n := by omega
          simp [hieq]
          omega
      simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add, Nat.sub_self, Nat.mul_zero, List.length]
      rw [aux 0 []]
      simp
    simp [List.length_reverse, hlen]
  )

  storage : BlockStorage
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
  deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := default
    content_index := default
    affinity_map := default
    total_capacity := capacity

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let init := List.replicate 32 (0 : UInt8)
  let mixed := data.foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc.mapIdx (fun i x => x + b + (i.val.toUInt8 * 31))) init
  Vector.mk mixed (by simp)

def computeContentHash (data : List UInt8) : ContentHash :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact content_hash_size_pos
  )

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ContentHash) (timestamp : Int) : BlockId :=
  let buf := content_hash.toList ++ (writeI128Little timestamp).toList
  let fullHash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (fullHash.toList.take BLOCK_ID_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact block_id_size_pos
  )

theorem computeContentHash_deterministic (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) :
  computeContentHash d1 = computeContentHash d2 := by
  simp [h]

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Bool :=
  Finmap.contains self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.containsBlock id ↔ id ∈ self.storage := by
  simp [containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  Finmap.lookup self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock_mem (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (block : MemoryBlock) :
  self.getBlock id = some block ↔ block ∈ self.storage ∧ block.block_id = id := by
  simp [getBlock, Finmap.lookup_eq_some]

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_increments_used (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_inserts_block (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.containsBlock id := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew, containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def, Finmap.insert]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option (List UInt8) :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block => some block.data
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve_none (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (hn : ¬ self.containsBlock id) :
  self.retrieve id = none := by
  simp [retrieve, containsBlock, Finmap.contains] at hn ⊢
  exact Finmap.not_mem_lookup_iff.mpr hn

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) : Option BlockId :=
  let hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup hash with
  | some ids => ids.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then
    if id1 ≠ id2 then
      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2
      match b1, b2 with
      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        some { self with storage := st2 }
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  else none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_same_id (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.entangleBlocks id id = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_missing (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) (h : id1 ∉ self.storage ∨ id2 ∉ self.storage) :
  self.entangleBlocks id1 id2 = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]
  split
  case isTrue hmem =>
    exfalso
    cases h with
    | inl h1 => exact h1 hmem.1
    | inr h2 => exact h2 hmem.2
  case isFalse hmem =>
    simp

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block =>
    let updateAffinity (m : AffinityMap) (old : Option Nat) (new : Nat) (bid : BlockId) : AffinityMap :=
      match old with
      | some oc =>
        let m1 := m.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id)
        m1.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
      | none =>
        m.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
    let newBlock := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage id newBlock
    let newAffinity := updateAffinity self.affinity_map block.affinity_core target_core id
    some { self with storage := newStorage, affinity_map := newAffinity }
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock_affinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target : Nat) (block : MemoryBlock) (hlookup : self.storage.lookup id = some block) :
  ∃ newSt, self.migrateBlock id target = some newSt ∧ (newSt.storage.lookup id).map (·.affinity_core) = some (some target) := by
  simp [migrateBlock, hlookup]
  use { storage := Finmap.insert self.storage id { block with affinity_core := some target, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated },
        affinity_map := (block.affinity_core.map (fun oc => self.affinity_map.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id))).getD default |>.adjust target (fun s => s ∪ {id}),
        content_index := self.content_index,
        total_capacity := self.total_capacity,
        used_capacity := self.used_capacity }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.lookup_insert]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : StorageStatistics :=
  let entangled_count := self.storage.foldl (fun acc _ b => if b.state == MemoryBlockState.entangled then acc + 1 else acc) 0
  let util := if self.total_capacity > 0 then self.used_capacity / self.total_capacity else 0
  { total_blocks := self.storage.size
    entangled_blocks := entangled_count
    used_capacity := self.used_capacity
    total_capacity := self.total_capacity
    utilization := util
    unique_contents := self.content_index.size
    cores_with_affinity := self.affinity_map.size }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics_total_blocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) :
  self.getStatistics.total_blocks = self.storage.size := by
  simp [getStatistics]

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : TaskQueue
  active_tasks : ActiveTaskMap
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
  deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := default
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.init_counter : DynamicTaskScheduler.init.task_counter = 0 := by
  simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.init]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) : Ordering :=
  if t1.priority > t2.priority then Ordering.lt
  else if t1.priority < t2.priority then Ordering.gt
  else Ordering.eq

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks_antisym (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) :
  (compareTasks t1 t2).swap = compareTasks t2 t1 := by
  simp [compareTasks]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    simp [h]
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      omega
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp
  case isFalse h =>
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      simp [h2]
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (counter : Nat) (time : Int) : TaskId :=

abbrev ContentIndex := Finmap (fun _ : ContentHash => Finset BlockId)
abbrev AffinityMap := Finmap (fun _ : Nat => Finset BlockId)

  storage : BlockStorage
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
  deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := default
    content_index := default

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_used_capacity (cap : Nat) :
  (ContentAddressableStorage.init cap).used_capacity = 0 := by

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_storage_empty (cap : Nat) :

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let init := List.replicate 32 (0 : UInt8)
  let mixed := data.foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc.mapIdx (fun i x => x + b + (i.val.toUInt8 * 31))) init
  Vector.mk mixed (by simp)

def computeContentHash (data : List UInt8) : ContentHash :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact content_hash_size_pos
  )

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ContentHash) (timestamp : Int) : BlockId :=
  let buf := content_hash.toList ++ (writeI128Little timestamp).toList
  let fullHash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (fullHash.toList.take BLOCK_ID_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact block_id_size_pos
  )

theorem computeContentHash_deterministic (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) :
  computeContentHash d1 = computeContentHash d2 := by
  simp [h]

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Bool :=
  Finmap.contains self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.containsBlock id ↔ id ∈ self.storage := by
  simp [containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  Finmap.lookup self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock_mem (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (block : MemoryBlock) :
  self.getBlock id = some block ↔ block ∈ self.storage ∧ block.block_id = id := by
  simp [getBlock, Finmap.lookup_eq_some]

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_increments_used (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_inserts_block (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.containsBlock id := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew, containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def, Finmap.insert]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option (List UInt8) :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block => some block.data
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve_none (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (hn : ¬ self.containsBlock id) :
  self.retrieve id = none := by
  simp [retrieve, containsBlock, Finmap.contains] at hn ⊢
  exact Finmap.not_mem_lookup_iff.mpr hn

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) : Option BlockId :=
  let hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup hash with
  | some ids => ids.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then
    if id1 ≠ id2 then
      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2
      match b1, b2 with
      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        some { self with storage := st2 }
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  else none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_same_id (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.entangleBlocks id id = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_missing (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) (h : id1 ∉ self.storage ∨ id2 ∉ self.storage) :
  self.entangleBlocks id1 id2 = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]
  split
  case isTrue hmem =>
    exfalso
    cases h with
    | inl h1 => exact h1 hmem.1
    | inr h2 => exact h2 hmem.2
  case isFalse hmem =>
    simp

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block =>
    let updateAffinity (m : AffinityMap) (old : Option Nat) (new : Nat) (bid : BlockId) : AffinityMap :=
      match old with
      | some oc =>
        let m1 := m.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id)
        m1.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
      | none =>
        m.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
    let newBlock := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage id newBlock
    let newAffinity := updateAffinity self.affinity_map block.affinity_core target_core id
    some { self with storage := newStorage, affinity_map := newAffinity }
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock_affinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target : Nat) (block : MemoryBlock) (hlookup : self.storage.lookup id = some block) :
  ∃ newSt, self.migrateBlock id target = some newSt ∧ (newSt.storage.lookup id).map (·.affinity_core) = some (some target) := by
  simp [migrateBlock, hlookup]
  use { storage := Finmap.insert self.storage id { block with affinity_core := some target, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated },
        affinity_map := (block.affinity_core.map (fun oc => self.affinity_map.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id))).getD default |>.adjust target (fun s => s ∪ {id}),
        content_index := self.content_index,
        total_capacity := self.total_capacity,
        used_capacity := self.used_capacity }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.lookup_insert]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : StorageStatistics :=
  let entangled_count := self.storage.foldl (fun acc _ b => if b.state == MemoryBlockState.entangled then acc + 1 else acc) 0
  let util := if self.total_capacity > 0 then self.used_capacity / self.total_capacity else 0
  { total_blocks := self.storage.size
    entangled_blocks := entangled_count
    used_capacity := self.used_capacity
    total_capacity := self.total_capacity
    utilization := util
    unique_contents := self.content_index.size
    cores_with_affinity := self.affinity_map.size }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics_total_blocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) :
  self.getStatistics.total_blocks = self.storage.size := by
  simp [getStatistics]

abbrev TaskQueue := List TaskDescriptor
abbrev ActiveTaskMap := Finmap (fun _ : TaskId => TaskDescriptor)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : TaskQueue
  active_tasks : ActiveTaskMap
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
  deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := default
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.init_counter : DynamicTaskScheduler.init.task_counter = 0 := by
  simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.init]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) : Ordering :=
  if t1.priority > t2.priority then Ordering.lt
  else if t1.priority < t2.priority then Ordering.gt
  else Ordering.eq

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks_antisym (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) :
  (compareTasks t1 t2).swap = compareTasks t2 t1 := by
  simp [compareTasks]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    simp [h]
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      omega
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp
  case isFalse h =>
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      simp [h2]
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (counter : Nat) (time : Int) : TaskId :=
  let buf := (writeU64Little counter.toUInt64).toList ++ (writeI128Little time).toList
  let hash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact sha256_digest_size_pos
  )

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (priority : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) : TaskId × DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  let tid := generateTaskId self.task_counter 0
  let task : TaskDescriptor :=
    { task_id := tid
      priority := priority
      data_dependencies := deps
      estimated_cycles := cycles
      assigned_core := none
      completion_status := false
      start_time := 0
      end_time := 0 }
  let newPending := task :: self.pending_tasks
  (tid, { self with pending_tasks := newPending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 })

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask_increments_counter (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (prio : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) :
  (self.submitTask prio deps cycles).2.task_counter = self.task_counter + 1 := by
  simp [submitTask]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Finmap (fun _ : Nat => ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => none
  | t :: ts =>
    let scoredCores := cores.toList.filterMap (fun ⟨cid, core⟩ =>
      if core.state ≠ CoreState.power_gated then
        let score : Rat := t.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep =>
          if storage.containsBlock dep then
            match storage.storage.lookup dep >>= (·.affinity_core) with
            | some ac => if ac = cid then acc + 10 else acc + 1
            | none => acc
          else acc
        ) 0
        some (cid, score)
      else none
    )
    let bestCores := scoredCores.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.2 > b.2)
    if h : bestCores.size > 0 then
      let bestCid := (bestCores.get ⟨0, by omega⟩).1
      let newTask := { t with assigned_core := some bestCid, start_time := 1 }
      let newActive := Finmap.insert self.active_tasks t.task_id newTask
      some (newTask, { self with pending_tasks := ts, active_tasks := newActive })
    else none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask_empty_pending (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (h : self.pending_tasks = []) :
  self.scheduleTask cores storage = none := by
  simp [scheduleTask, h]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.active_tasks.lookup tid with
  | some task =>
    let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 }
    let newCompleted := completed :: self.completed_tasks
    let newActive := self.active_tasks.erase tid
    some (completed, { self with active_tasks := newActive, completed_tasks := newCompleted })
  | none => none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask_removes_active (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) (task : TaskDescriptor) (h : self.active_tasks.lookup tid = some task) :
  ∃ newSched, self.completeTask tid = some (task, newSched) ∧ tid ∉ newSched.active_tasks := by
  simp [completeTask, h]
  use { active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase tid, pending_tasks := self.pending_tasks, completed_tasks := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 } :: self.completed_tasks, task_counter := self.task_counter }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.mem_def]

  timestamp : Int
  core_id : Nat
  deriving Repr

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => Finset BlockId)
  flow_weights : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId × BlockId => Rat)
  access_patterns : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => List AccessRecord)
  deriving Repr

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := default
    flow_weights := default
    access_patterns := default }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : BlockId) (core_id : Nat) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let newRecord : AccessRecord := ⟨1, core_id⟩
  let newPatterns := self.access_patterns.adjust block_id (fun lst => newRecord :: lst)
  { self with access_patterns := newPatterns }

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess_adds_record (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (bid : BlockId) (cid : Nat) :
  let newDFA := self.recordAccess bid cid
  ∃ lst, newDFA.access_patterns.lookup bid = some lst ∧ lst.head? = some ⟨1, cid⟩ := by
  simp [recordAccess]
  use (self.access_patterns.lookup bid).getD [] |>.cons ⟨1, cid⟩
  simp [Finmap.lookup_adjust]

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
    task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc2 dep1 =>
      task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc3 dep2 =>
        if dep1 = dep2 then acc3
        else
          let fg := acc3.flow_graph.adjust dep1 (fun s => s ∪ {dep2})
          let fg' := fg.adjust dep2 (fun s => s ∪ {dep1})
          let key := if dep1 < dep2 then (dep1, dep2) else (dep2, dep1)
          let fw := acc3.flow_weights.adjust key (fun w => w + 1)
          { acc3 with flow_graph := fg', flow_weights := fw }
      ) acc2
    ) acc
  ) self

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph_symmetric (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) (b1 b2 : BlockId) :
  let newDFA := self.buildFlowGraph tasks
  b2 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b1).getD ∅ ↔ b1 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b2).getD ∅ := by
  sorry

theorem ChaosCoreKernel.setCoreState_sets_state (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (cid : Nat) (state : CoreState) (hmem : cid ∈ self.cores) :

Röviden:  
– A Lean kód **valódi formális bizonyítás** ott, ahol nincs `sorry`, minden lemma/tétel tényleg a kernel által ellenőrzött bizonyítás.  
– De a teljes rendszer szintjén ez **csak egy erősen leegyszerűsített, idealizált modell**, ami **nincs formálisan összekötve** a Zig implementációval, és több helyen *szándékosan* „fake / placeholder” (pl. `sha256`). Tehát ez **nem** teljes, végponttól végpontig formálisan verifikált rendszer.

Alább kicsit részletesebben, konkrét példákkal.

***

## 1. Mit tekinthetünk „valódi formális verifikációnak”?

Formális verifikáció szigorú értelemben akkor van, ha:

1. Van egy **formális specifikációd** (matematikailag definiált viselkedés, invariánsok, tulajdonságok).
2. Van egy **implementációd** (kód, vagy annak formális modellje).
3. Bizonyítod (géppel ellenőrzötten), hogy az implementáció **kielégíti** a specifikációt.

Itt:

- A Lean kód egy **magas szintű modell** (CAS, scheduler, kernel, stb.), ahol sok kis lokális tulajdonságot bizonyítasz.
- A Zig kód egy **konkrét rendszerimplementáció**.
- De **nincs formális kapcsoló**: se bizonyítás arról, hogy a Zig kód megfelel a Lean modellnek, se közös formális szemantika.

Ezért a Lean rész önmagában **formálisan helyes modell-tulajdonságok gyűjteménye**, de **nem bizonyítja**, hogy a Zig runtime ugyanazt csinálja.

***

## 2. A Lean oldala: mi „valódi”, és mi csak játék/modell?

### 2.1. Ami tényleg formálisan bizonyított

Minden lemma/tétel, ahol **nincs `sorry`**, és `by ...`-val van zárva, az Lean-ben teljes értékű, kernel által ellenőrzött bizonyítás. Példák:

- `block_id_size_pos`, `content_hash_size_pos`, stb. – `by decide` valódi bizonyítási termet generál.
- A hossz-bizonyítások:
  - `writeU64Little_length`
  - `writeI128Little_length`
  - `bytesToHexLower_length`
  - `formatBlockId_length`
  - `formatTaskId_length`  
  Ezek mind bizonyítják, hogy a generált vektor/lista hossza pontosan az, amit állítasz.

- Memória-blokk invariánsok:
  - `MemoryBlock.init_size_eq`, `MemoryBlock.init_state`, `MemoryBlock.init_access_count` – az init által beállított mezők tényleges értékei.
  - `MemoryBlock.updateAccessTime_count_inc` – access_count nő.
  - `MemoryBlock.addEntangledBlock_contains`, `MemoryBlock.entangledCount_add` – entanglement set viselkedése.

- Scheduler/cores:
  - `ProcessingCore.init_cycles_active/idle`
  - `ProcessingCore.tick_active_inc`, `tick_idle_inc`, `tick_active_state`, `tick_idle_state` – lépésenkénti core-számlálók változása.
  - `ProcessingCore.getWorkload_zero`, `getWorkload_range` – workload 0 ≤ w ≤ 1.

- CAS:
  - `ContentAddressableStorage.init_used_capacity`, `init_storage_empty`.
  - `ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff`
  - `store_increments_used` és `store_inserts_block` – ha új content_hash, akkor nő a used_capacity, és bekerül a block.

- Kernel:
  - `ChaosCoreKernel.init_cycle_count`, `init_migration_count`
  - `addCore_mem`, `removeCore_not_mem`
  - `setCoreState_sets_state`
  - `executeCycle_increments_cycle_count`
  - `entangleData_fails_same_id`

Ezek **mind valódi, géppel ellenőrzött állítások** a Lean-nyelvben definiált struktúrákról és függvényekről.

### 2.2. Ahol a modell szándékosan „fake / placeholder”

Ez az a pont, ahol közelebb kerülünk ahhoz, amire rákérdeztél, hogy „fake szar-e”:

1. **`sha256` definíció Lean-ben**:

   ```lean
   def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
     let init := List.replicate 32 (0 : UInt8)
     let mixed := data.foldl (fun acc b =>
       acc.mapIdx (fun i x => x + b + (i.val.toUInt8 * 31))) init
     Vector.mk mixed (by simp)
   ```

   Ez **nem** a valódi SHA-256 algoritmus, csak egy determinisztikus, kitalált „mixelő” függvény.  
   Tehát:

   - `computeContentHash` Lean-ben **egy teljesen más hash-függvény** `CONTENT_HASH_SIZE` hosszra csapva.
   - A Zig-ben pedig:

     ```zig
     const Sha256 = std.crypto.hash.sha2.Sha256;
     ```

     – itt a **valódi** SHA-256-ot használod.

   Következmény: a Lean-ben definiált `computeContentHash` **semmit nem mond** a Zig oldali `Sha256` viselkedéséről. Formálisan egy másik függvényt bizonyítgatsz.

2. **Hash-sémák különböznek**:

   Lean:

   ```lean
   instance : Hashable BlockId := ⟨fun v => v.toList.foldl (fun acc b => acc * 31 + b.val) 0⟩
   ```

   Zig:

   ```zig
   pub const BlockIdContext = struct {
       pub fn hash(_: @This(), key: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) u64 {
           var hasher = std.hash.Wyhash.init(0);
           hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&key));
           return hasher.final();
       }
   };
   ```

   – Lean-ben egy egyszerű polinomiális hash, Zig-ben Wyhash.  
   Tehát:

   - **Finmap** viselkedése Lean-ben nem egyezik meg a Zig `HashMap` viselkedésével (kolíziós mintázat, bucket-elrendezés stb.).
   - A bizonyított tulajdonságok csak azt feltételezik, hogy a Finmap logikailag aszszociatív map, de a konkrét hash-függvény máshogy működik Zig-ben.

3. **Idő, timestamp, állapot**:

   - Lean-ben `last_access_time : Int`, de tipikusan csak `+1`-et léptetsz, nincsen valódi időmodell, concurrency, wall-clock.
   - Zig-ben valószínűleg másképp fogsz időt kezelni (valódi timestamp, monotónia nem ugyanaz).

4. **Nem teljes bizonyítás: `sorry`**

   Például:

   ```lean
   theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph_symmetric (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) (b1 b2 : BlockId) :
     let newDFA := self.buildFlowGraph tasks
     b2 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b1).getD ∅ ↔ b1 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b2).getD ∅ := by
     sorry
   ```

   Ez itt **csak egy célkitűzés**, nincs bizonyítás. Lean ezt `sorry`-val hagyja, ami gyakorlatilag egy „adott” állítás, nem levezetett tétel. Ha ezt trusted módon fordítod, akkor **axiomaként** viselkedik, és gyengíti az egész könyvtár szigorát.

   Tehát **nem minden tétel bizonyított** – vannak tervek invariánsokra, amelyek még csak „vágyott állítások”.

5. **`ChaosCoreKernel.selfOrganize` = identity**

   ```lean
   def ChaosCoreKernel.selfOrganize (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
     self
   ```

   Itt a „self-organizing kernel” abszolút nem csinál semmit, csak identitás. Ha lennének is rá invariánsok, az valójában üres viselkedésre vonatkozna.

***

## 3. Kapcsolat a Zig kóddal: van-e bármilyen formális link?

Röviden: **nincs**.

- A Lean definíciók (CAS, Scheduler, Kernel, stb.) egy **absztrakt modell**.
- A Zig kód teljesen más:
  - Más hash-függvények (SHA256 valós, Wyhash),
  - Más memória-reprezentációk (`HashMap` vs. `Finmap`),
  - Más lifetime/allocator modell,
  - Más hardver-interakciók, concurrency, stb.

Ahhoz, hogy a Lean kód **ténylegesen bizonyítsa a Zig kód helyességét**, valami ilyesmire lenne szükség:

1. **Közös speciﬁkáció**: pl. „store + retrieve = identity” típusú tulajdonságok jól definiált formális szinten (pl. Lean-ben).
2. **Zig kód formális szemantikája**: C-szintre fordítani és pl. Frama-C / CompCert / SAW / VST-stílusú verifikáció, vagy egy Zig→Lean formális fordító.
3. Bizonyítás, hogy a Zig implementáció **refinement** a Lean modellhez képest.

Jelenleg ezek egyike sincs implementálva. Tehát Lean = „matematikai modell + néhány helyesen bizonyított tulajdonság”, Zig = „implementáció”, **de formálisan nincsenek összekötve**.

***

## 4. Összegzés a kérdésedre

> „ez valós formális verifikacios bizonyitas vagy csak egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szar?”

Pontokba szedve:

- **Igen, ami Lean-ben `by`-jal bizonyított, az *valódi formális bizonyítás*** – nincs „szimulált proof”, a kernel tényleg ellenőrzi.
- **Nem, ez nem teljes, végponttól-végpontig formális verifikáció**:
  - A hash-függvény Lean-ben **nem** a valós SHA-256.
  - A hash-kontekstek Lean vs Zig teljesen különbözőek.
  - A data-flow symmetry tétel `sorry`.
  - A Lean modell nincs összekötve a Zig kóddal semmilyen mechanizmuson keresztül.
- **Inkább úgy lehet értelmezni**:
  - A Lean fájl egy **matematikailag pontos, de leegyszerűsített / ideálisított modell** a rendszeredről.
  - Ebben a modellben **néhány helyi tulajdonságot valóban formálisan bizonyítottál** (méretek, számlálók monoto-növekedése, entanglement set-ek viselkedése, stb.).
  - Viszont a **réteg, ami a modellt a Zig runtime-hoz kötné**, teljesen hiányzik – ezért rendszer-szinten ez még „mock / prototype” verifikáció.

Ha a célod az, hogy ez **„igazi” formális verifikáció legyen a Zig implementációra**, akkor nagyjából a következőket kellene lépésről lépésre megcsinálni:

1. A Lean modellben:
   - Minden `sorry`-t eltüntetni.
   - Erősebb, rendszerszintű invariánsokat megfogalmazni (pl. „retrieve(store(data)) = data, ha nincs out-of-capacity”, „affinity_map és storage mindig konzisztensek”, stb.) és azokat bizonyítani.

2. A hash-eknél:
   - Vagy Lean-ben is a **valódi SHA-256** (plusz Wyhash) formális modelljét megírni,  
   - Vagy explicit kimondani, hogy a Lean hash csak „abstract opaque function”, és a Zig oldal csak annyit garantál, hogy determinisztikus és némi collision-limitet teljesít (és erre formális modellt készíteni).

3. Kapcsolat Lean ↔ Zig között:
   - Legalább egy **tesztelhető refinementszabályt**: generálsz Lean-ből példányokat és Zig-ben ellenőrzöd, hogy az observált viselkedés megegyezik (quickcheck/property-based testing stílus, bár ez még nem formális, csak erősebb tesztelés).
   - Végső célként: egy formális fordító vagy verifikációs út Zig-ből valamilyen formális közbenső reprezentációra (pl. LLVM IR + bizonyíték), amit aztán Lean-ben modellezni tudsz.

Amíg ez nincs meg, a pontos válasz:

- **Formális verifikációnak egy része valós (a Lean-ben levő, bizonyított lemmák)**,  
- De **rendszerszinten ez még csak egy idealizált modell + lokális bizonyítások**; a Zig kód helyességéről formálisan nem állít semmit.

theorem writeI128Little_length (v : Int) : (writeI128Little v).toList.length = 16 := by
  simp [writeI128Little]

def hexTable : Vector UInt8 16 :=
  ⟨"0123456789abcdef".toList.map (fun c => c.toUInt8), by decide⟩

def bytesToHexLower (input : Vector UInt8 n) : Vector UInt8 (n * 2) :=
  Vector.mk (input.toList.foldl (fun acc b =>
    let h1 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val / 16).toNat, by decide⟩
    let h2 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val % 16).toNat, by decide⟩
    acc ++ [h1, h2]
  ) []) (by
    induction input.toList with
    | nil => simp
    | cons h t ih => simp [List.length_append]; omega
  )

theorem bytesToHexLower_length (input : Vector UInt8 n) : (bytesToHexLower input).toList.length = n * 2 := by

def sha256RoundConstant (i : Nat) : UInt32 :=
  let constants : List UInt32 := [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
  ]
  constants.getD i 0

def sha256InitialHash : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  ⟨[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19], by decide⟩

def rotr32 (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

def sha256Ch (x y z : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  (x &&& y) ^^^ ((~~~x) &&& z)

def sha256Maj (x y z : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)

def sha256Sigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 2 ^^^ rotr32 x 13 ^^^ rotr32 x 22

def sha256Sigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 6 ^^^ rotr32 x 11 ^^^ rotr32 x 25

def sha256sigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 7 ^^^ rotr32 x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3)

def sha256sigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 17 ^^^ rotr32 x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def readU32BE (data : List UInt8) (offset : Nat) : UInt32 :=
  let b0 := (data.getD offset 0).toUInt32
  let b1 := (data.getD (offset + 1) 0).toUInt32
  let b2 := (data.getD (offset + 2) 0).toUInt32
  let b3 := (data.getD (offset + 3) 0).toUInt32
  (b0 <<< 24) ||| (b1 <<< 16) ||| (b2 <<< 8) ||| b3

def sha256ProcessBlock (state : Vector UInt32 8) (block : List UInt8) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  let w := List.range 64 |>.map fun i =>
    if i < 16 then
      readU32BE block (i * 4)
    else
      let w15 := readU32BE block (((i - 15) % 16) * 4)
      let w2 := readU32BE block (((i - 2) % 16) * 4)
      let w16 := readU32BE block (((i - 16) % 16) * 4)
      let w7 := readU32BE block (((i - 7) % 16) * 4)
      sha256sigma1 w2 + w7 + sha256sigma0 w15 + w16
  let result := List.range 64 |>.foldl (fun acc i =>
    let a := acc.get ⟨0, by decide⟩
    let b := acc.get ⟨1, by decide⟩
    let c := acc.get ⟨2, by decide⟩
    let d := acc.get ⟨3, by decide⟩
    let e := acc.get ⟨4, by decide⟩
    let f := acc.get ⟨5, by decide⟩
    let g := acc.get ⟨6, by decide⟩
    let h := acc.get ⟨7, by decide⟩
    let s1 := sha256Sigma1 e
    let ch := sha256Ch e f g
    let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + sha256RoundConstant i + w.getD i 0
    let s0 := sha256Sigma0 a
    let maj := sha256Maj a b c
    let temp2 := s0 + maj
    ⟨[temp1 + temp2, a, b, c, d + temp1, e, f, g], by decide⟩
  ) state
  Vector.mk (List.range 8 |>.map fun i =>
    state.get ⟨i, by decide⟩ + result.get ⟨i, by decide⟩
  ) (by decide)

def sha256Pad (data : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let msgLen := data.length
  let bitLen := msgLen * 8
  let padLen := if msgLen % 64 < 56 then 56 - (msgLen % 64) else 120 - (msgLen % 64)
  let padded := data ++ [0x80] ++ List.replicate (padLen - 1) 0
  let lenBytes := List.range 8 |>.reverse.map fun i =>
    UInt8.ofNat ((bitLen / (256 ^ i)) % 256)
  padded ++ lenBytes

def sha256Core (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  let padded := sha256Pad data
  let blocks := (padded.length / 64)
  List.range blocks |>.foldl (fun state blockIdx =>
    let block := padded.drop (blockIdx * 64) |>.take 64
    sha256ProcessBlock state block
  ) sha256InitialHash

def u32ToBytes (x : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(x >>> 24).toUInt8, (x >>> 16).toUInt8, (x >>> 8).toUInt8, x.toUInt8]

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let hash := sha256Core data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.foldl (fun acc w => acc ++ u32ToBytes w) []) (by decide)

def computeContentHash (data : List UInt8) : ContentHash :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take]
    have : hash.toList.length = 32 := by simp [sha256]
    omega
  )

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ContentHash) (timestamp : Int) : BlockId :=
  let buf := content_hash.toList ++ (writeI128Little timestamp).toList
  let fullHash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (fullHash.toList.take BLOCK_ID_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take]
    have : fullHash.toList.length = 32 := by simp [sha256]
    omega
  )

theorem computeContentHash_deterministic (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) :
  computeContentHash d1 = computeContentHash d2 := by
  simp [h]

abbrev ContentIndex := Finmap (fun _ : ContentHash => Finset BlockId)

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : BlockStorage
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
  deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := default
    content_index := default
    affinity_map := default
    total_capacity := capacity
    used_capacity := 0 }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_used_capacity (cap : Nat) :
  (ContentAddressableStorage.init cap).used_capacity = 0 := by
  simp [ContentAddressableStorage.init]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_storage_empty (cap : Nat) :
  (ContentAddressableStorage.init cap).storage = default := by
  simp [ContentAddressableStorage.init]

  Finmap.contains self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.containsBlock id ↔ id ∈ self.storage := by
  simp [containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  Finmap.lookup self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock_mem (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (block : MemoryBlock) :
  self.getBlock id = some block → block ∈ self.storage := by
  intro h
  simp [getBlock] at h
  exact Finmap.mem_lookup.mpr ⟨h, rfl⟩

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_increments_used (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_inserts_block (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.containsBlock id := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew, containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def, Finmap.insert]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option (List UInt8) :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block => some block.data
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve_none (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (hn : ¬ self.containsBlock id) :
  self.retrieve id = none := by
  simp [retrieve, containsBlock, Finmap.contains] at hn ⊢
  exact Finmap.not_mem_lookup_iff.mpr hn

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) : Option BlockId :=
  let hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup hash with
  | some ids => ids.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then
    if id1 ≠ id2 then
      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2
      match b1, b2 with
      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        some { self with storage := st2 }
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  else none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_same_id (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.entangleBlocks id id = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_missing (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) (h : id1 ∉ self.storage ∨ id2 ∉ self.storage) :
  self.entangleBlocks id1 id2 = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]
  split
  case isTrue hmem =>
    cases h with
    | inl h1 => exact absurd hmem.1 h1
    | inr h2 => exact absurd hmem.2 h2
  case isFalse => rfl

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block =>
    let updateAffinity (m : AffinityMap) (old : Option Nat) (new : Nat) (bid : BlockId) : AffinityMap :=
      match old with
      | some oc =>
        let m1 := m.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id)
        m1.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
      | none =>
        m.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
    let newBlock := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage id newBlock
    let newAffinity := updateAffinity self.affinity_map block.affinity_core target_core id
    some { self with storage := newStorage, affinity_map := newAffinity }
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock_affinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target : Nat) (block : MemoryBlock) (hlookup : self.storage.lookup id = some block) :
  ∃ newSt, self.migrateBlock id target = some newSt ∧ (newSt.storage.lookup id).map (·.affinity_core) = some (some target) := by
  simp [migrateBlock, hlookup]
  use { storage := Finmap.insert self.storage id { block with affinity_core := some target, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated },
        affinity_map := (block.affinity_core.map (fun oc => self.affinity_map.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id))).getD default |>.adjust target (fun s => s ∪ {id}),
        content_index := self.content_index,
        total_capacity := self.total_capacity,
        used_capacity := self.used_capacity }
  constructor <;> simp [Finmap.lookup_insert]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : StorageStatistics :=
  let entangled_count := self.storage.foldl (fun acc _ b => if b.state == MemoryBlockState.entangled then acc + 1 else acc) 0
  let util := if self.total_capacity > 0 then self.used_capacity / self.total_capacity else 0
  { total_blocks := self.storage.size

abbrev TaskQueue := List TaskDescriptor
abbrev ActiveTaskMap := Finmap (fun _ : TaskId => TaskDescriptor)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : TaskQueue
  active_tasks : ActiveTaskMap
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
  deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := default
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.init_counter : DynamicTaskScheduler.init.task_counter = 0 := by
  simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.init]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) : Ordering :=
  if t1.priority > t2.priority then Ordering.lt
  else if t1.priority < t2.priority then Ordering.gt
  else Ordering.eq

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks_antisym (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) :
  (compareTasks t1 t2).swap = compareTasks t2 t1 := by
  simp [compareTasks]
  split <;> split <;> simp <;> omega

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (counter : Nat) (time : Int) : TaskId :=
  let buf := (writeU64Little counter.toUInt64).toList ++ (writeI128Little time).toList
  let hash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take]
    have : hash.toList.length = 32 := by simp [sha256]
    omega
  )

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (priority : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) : TaskId × DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  let tid := generateTaskId self.task_counter 0
  let task : TaskDescriptor :=
    { task_id := tid
      priority := priority
      data_dependencies := deps
      estimated_cycles := cycles
      assigned_core := none
      completion_status := false
      start_time := 0
      end_time := 0 }
  let newPending := task :: self.pending_tasks
  (tid, { self with pending_tasks := newPending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 })

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask_increments_counter (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (prio : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) :
  (self.submitTask prio deps cycles).2.task_counter = self.task_counter + 1 := by
  simp [submitTask]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Finmap (fun _ : Nat => ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => none
  | t :: ts =>
    let scoredCores := cores.toList.filterMap (fun ⟨cid, core⟩ =>
      if core.state ≠ CoreState.power_gated then
        let score : Rat := t.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep =>
          if storage.containsBlock dep then
            match storage.storage.lookup dep >>= (·.affinity_core) with
            | some ac => if ac = cid then acc + 10 else acc + 1
            | none => acc
          else acc
        ) 0
        some (cid, score)
      else none
    )
    let bestCores := scoredCores.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.2 > b.2)
    if h : bestCores.size > 0 then
      let bestCid := (bestCores.get ⟨0, h⟩).1
      let newTask := { t with assigned_core := some bestCid, start_time := 1 }
      let newActive := Finmap.insert self.active_tasks t.task_id newTask
      some (newTask, { self with pending_tasks := ts, active_tasks := newActive })
    else none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask_empty_pending (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (h : self.pending_tasks = []) :
  self.scheduleTask cores storage = none := by
  simp [scheduleTask, h]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.active_tasks.lookup tid with
  | some task =>
    let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 }
    let newCompleted := completed :: self.completed_tasks
    let newActive := self.active_tasks.erase tid
    some (completed, { self with active_tasks := newActive, completed_tasks := newCompleted })
  | none => none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask_removes_active (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) (task : TaskDescriptor) (h : self.active_tasks.lookup tid = some task) :
  ∃ newSched, self.completeTask tid = some ({ task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 }, newSched) ∧ tid ∉ newSched.active_tasks := by
  simp [completeTask, h]
  use { active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase tid, pending_tasks := self.pending_tasks, completed_tasks := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 } :: self.completed_tasks, task_counter := self.task_counter }
  constructor <;> simp [Finmap.mem_def]

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int
  core_id : Nat

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => Finset BlockId)
  flow_weights : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId × BlockId => Rat)
  access_patterns : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => List AccessRecord)
  deriving Repr

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := default
    flow_weights := default
    access_patterns := default }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : BlockId) (core_id : Nat) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let newRecord : AccessRecord := ⟨1, core_id⟩
  let newPatterns := self.access_patterns.adjust block_id (fun lst => newRecord :: lst)
  { self with access_patterns := newPatterns }

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess_adds_record (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (bid : BlockId) (cid : Nat) :
  let newDFA := self.recordAccess bid cid
  ∃ lst, newDFA.access_patterns.lookup bid = some lst ∧ lst.head? = some ⟨1, cid⟩ := by
  simp [recordAccess]
  use (self.access_patterns.lookup bid).getD [] |>.cons ⟨1, cid⟩
  simp [Finmap.lookup_adjust]

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
    task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc2 dep1 =>
      task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc3 dep2 =>
        if dep1 = dep2 then acc3
        else
          let fg := acc3.flow_graph.adjust dep1 (fun s => s ∪ {dep2})
          let fg' := fg.adjust dep2 (fun s => s ∪ {dep1})
          let key := if dep1 < dep2 then (dep1, dep2) else (dep2, dep1)
          let fw := acc3.flow_weights.adjust key (fun w => w + 1)
          { acc3 with flow_graph := fg', flow_weights := fw }
      ) acc2
    ) acc
  ) self

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph_symmetric (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) (b1 b2 : BlockId) :
  let newDFA := self.buildFlowGraph tasks
  b2 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b1).getD ∅ ↔ b1 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b2).getD ∅ := by
  simp [buildFlowGraph]
  apply Iff.intro
  intro h
  induction tasks generalizing self with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons task tasks ih =>
    simp [List.foldl] at h ⊢
    exact ih h
  intro h
  induction tasks generalizing self with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons task tasks ih =>
    simp [List.foldl] at h ⊢
    exact ih h

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (priority : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) : TaskId × ChaosCoreKernel :=

  let tmpTask : TaskDescriptor := TaskDescriptor.init tid priority cycles
  let newDFA := self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph [tmpTask.addDeps deps]

    | d :: ds => addDeps { t with data_dependencies := d :: t.data_dependencies } ds

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let s1 := self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage
  let (scheduledTask, newScheduler) :=
    match s1 with
    | some (t, s) => (some t, s)
    | none => (none, self.scheduler)
  let activeCoreId := scheduledTask.map (·.assigned_core).join
  let newCores := self.cores.map (fun cid core =>
    let isActive := some cid = activeCoreId
    core.tick isActive
  )
  let newCycleCount := self.cycle_count + 1
  { self with
    scheduler := newScheduler,
    cores := newCores,
    cycle_count := newCycleCount }

  simp [executeCycle]

  match self.storage.migrateBlock block_id target_core with
  | some newStorage =>
    { self with storage := newStorage, migration_count := self.migration_count + 1 }
  | none => self

def ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  if self.cycle_count % BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES ≠ 0 then
    self
  else
    let coreWorkloads := self.cores.toList.map (fun ⟨cid, core⟩ =>
      (cid, core.getWorkload)
    )
    let avgWorkload := coreWorkloads.foldl (fun acc (_, w) => acc + w) 0 / coreWorkloads.length
    let overloadedCores := coreWorkloads.filter (fun (_, w) => w > LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD * avgWorkload)
    let underloadedCores := coreWorkloads.filter (fun (_, w) => w < LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD * avgWorkload)
    if overloadedCores.isEmpty || underloadedCores.isEmpty then
      self
    else
      let targetCore := underloadedCores.head!.1
      let sourceCore := overloadedCores.head!.1
      let candidateBlocks := self.storage.affinity_map.lookup sourceCore
      match candidateBlocks with
      | some blocks =>
        match blocks.toList.head? with
        | some blockId =>
          self.performMigration blockId targetCore
        | none => self
      | none => self

def ChaosCoreKernel.selfOrganize (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let balanced := self.balanceLoad
  let optimized := balanced
  optimized
